name: yorga-tareas
description: Gestor de tareas del Grupo Yorga (proyectos, tablero, comentarios, adjuntos, API + MCP).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run preflight && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && until docker exec yorga-tareas-db pg_isready -U tareas >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
